family.amstrad-pc7000.description: PCs for getting started with DOS and Windows, with 286, 386SX and 486SLC configurations.
family.amstrad-pc7000.history: Amstrad advertised the PC7000 series in November 1992 as an introduction to the PC, with preinstalled software and a tutorial. The PC7286 provided the 286 option, while the PC7386SX offered higher specifications and Super VGA. The 7286 Family Pack continued the games bundles of the PC5286 and PC4386SX. PC7486SLC-33 documentation records a later offering with DOS 6 and Windows 3.1. SLC33 and SLC80 remain separate: the specimens and their firmware do not establish one configuration for both.
